abilities.name: Agile Attack
abilities.description:
Attack primary target for <color=#86e619>270%</color> damage + Chain to <color=#86e619>2</color> adjacent enemies for <color=#86e619>270%</color> damage.

Gain <color=#fff568>Evade</color>.
If this character already had <color=#fff568>Evade</color>, gain <color=#fff568>Speed Up</color>.

abilities.name: Web Slinger
abilities.description:
Attack primary target for <color=#86e619>360%</color> damage + clear <color=#86e619>3</color> positive effects + apply <color=#fff568>Defense Down</color> for <color=#86e619>2</color> turns and <color=#fff568>Slow</color> for <color=#86e619>2</color> turns.

Chain to <color=#86e619>4</color> adjacent enemies for <color=#86e619>360%</color> damage + clear <color=#86e619>3</color> positive effects + apply <color=#fff568>Defense Down</color> <color=#86e619>2</color> turns and <color=#fff568>Slow</color> for <color=#86e619>2</color> turns.

This attack is Unavoidable, cannot be counterattacked, and this attack can Chain to <color=#fff568>Stealth</color> targets.

abilities.name: Tangled Web
abilities.description:
Attack primary target for <color=#86e619>500%</color> damage.

With <color=#86e619>3</color> <color=#fff568>HERO</color> allies, reduce <color=#fff568>Safeguard</color> by <color=#86e619>1</color> on primary target.
With <color=#86e619>3</color> <color=#fff568>AMAZING AVENGERS</color>, reduce <color=#fff568>Safeguard</color> by <color=#86e619>2</color> instead.

Clear all positive effects on the primary target + apply <color=#fff568>Stun</color> and <color=#fff568>Slow</color>.

abilities.name: Spidey-Sense
abilities.description:
On Spawn, with <color=#86e619>3</color> <color=#fff568>AMAZING AVENGER</color> allies, apply <color=#86e619>2</color> <color=#fff568>Evade</color> to self and all <color=#fff568>AMAZING AVENGER</color> allies.

On Dodge:
 > Fill Speed Bar by <color=#86e619>15%</color>.
 > Generate <color=#86e619>1</color> Ability Energy for self.

Gain +<color=#86e619>25%</color> Dodge Chance.
Gain +<color=#86e619>25%</color> Dodge Chance if there's a <color=#fff568>VILLAIN</color> <color=#fff568>SPIDER-VERSE</color> enemy.
